ar.source: Lately you’ve posted about {items}. Add these as featured hashtags?
ar.before: نشرت مؤخرًا عن ⁨{items}⁩. هل تريد إضافتها إلى وسومك البارزة؟
ar.after: نشرت مؤخرًا عن ⁨{items}⁩. هل تريد إضافتها إلى وسومك المميزة؟
ar.reason: The callout uses «البارزة» for featured hashtags, while the profile editor where users manage them calls them «الوسوم المميزة».
ar.judgeNote: Both are accurate and fluent. 'البارزة' and 'المميزة' are both acceptable for 'featured'.

ar.before: يطابق المحتوى مرشّح «{title}»
ar.after: يطابق المحتوى عامل التصفية «⁨{title}⁩»
ar.reason: The warning calls the filter «مرشّح» while its settings call it «عامل التصفية», and the user-defined title lacks bidirectional isolation.
ar.judgeNote: Both are accurate and keep the placeholders. A uses the standard Mastodon term عامل التصفية and adds bidi isolation; مرشّح in B is also acceptable.

ar.before: هل تريد إزالة منشورك من الاقتباس؟
ar.after: هل تريد إزالة المنشور؟

ar.judgeNote: B is a literal translation. A adds context (removing your post from the quote) that fits the revoke-quote modal. Both work.

ar.before: حذف الخلاصة
ar.after: حذف الموجز
ar.reason: The delete action calls the custom feed «الخلاصة», while the feed list and editor call the same item «الموجز».
ar.judgeNote: Both موجز and خلاصة are valid for 'feed'. Neither candidate is consistent across the feed strings, and both mix the terms to the same degree.

ar.before: تعديل الخلاصة
ar.after: تعديل الموجز
ar.reason: This menu item says «تعديل الخلاصة», but it opens an editor titled «تعديل الموجز المخصص».
ar.judgeNote: Both are correct. Both candidates mix the two terms for 'feed' equally.

ar.before: خيارات الخلاصة
ar.after: خيارات الموجز
ar.reason: The options label uses «الخلاصة» for the same feed called «الموجز» on its editing and membership screens.
ar.judgeNote: Both are correct and use valid terms.

ar.source: There is nothing in this custom feed yet. When members of this feed post new statuses, they will appear here.
ar.before: لا توجد منشورات في هذه الخلاصة المخصصة بعد. ستظهر هنا منشورات أعضائها الجديدة.
ar.after: لا توجد منشورات في هذا الموجز المخصص بعد. ستظهر هنا منشورات أعضائه الجديدة.
ar.reason: The empty state calls the feature «الخلاصة المخصصة», while the navigation and creation screens use «موجز مخصص».
ar.judgeNote: Both are fluent and accurate, with correct gender agreement for each chosen noun.

ar.after: إضافة ⁦{name}⁩ إلى الموجزات المخصصة
ar.reason: The dialog calls the feature «الخلاصات المخصصة», while its navigation tab and page heading both call it «الموجزات المخصصة».
ar.judgeNote: Both are correct and keep the placeholder isolated.

ar.before: اسم الخلاصة الجديدة
ar.after: اسم الموجز الجديد
ar.reason: The same field on the feed creation page is labeled «اسم الموجز», so «اسم الخلاصة الجديدة» switches terms for the same item.
ar.judgeNote: Both are correct, with the adjective agreeing in each case.

ar.source: You'll still be able to accept, reject, or report users

ar.after: سيظل بإمكانك قبول المستخدمين أو رفضهم أو الإبلاغ عنهم
ar.reason: «طلبات المستخدمين» changes the object of acceptance and rejection from users to their requests and suggests that users submitted a request.
ar.judgeNote: A spells out that the user accepts requests, which is accurate in this context. B is literal and still clear.

ar.before: عدم عرض هذا الاقتراح مجددًا
ar.after: عدم العرض مجددًا
ar.reason: «هذا الاقتراح» means one suggestion, but the same label also appears on the button that hides the entire follow-suggestions section.
ar.judgeNote: A is literal. B adds 'this suggestion', which matches the card context. Both are acceptable.

ar.before: عرض المنشورات المروّجة
ar.after: عرض الترويجات
ar.reason: «المنشورات المروّجة» can read as promoted posts, while this toggle controls boosts, consistently called «الترويجات» in the other timeline filters.
ar.judgeNote: A's 'boosted posts' is clearer. B's الترويجات is a less natural noun for this setting.
